command_line:
set +e
mkdir -p .pkg .deps
python3 -m pip download --isolated --disable-pip-version-check --no-deps --dest .pkg 'caper==2.3.2' > probe.txt 2>&1
printf 'download_rc=%s\n' "$?" >> probe.txt
python3 -c 'import glob,zipfile; p=glob.glob(".pkg/caper*.whl")[0]; zipfile.ZipFile(p).extractall(".deps")' >> probe.txt 2>&1
printf 'extract_rc=%s\n' "$?" >> probe.txt
for mod in requests OpenSSL autouri WDL humanfriendly numpy pandas sklearn matplotlib pyhocon; do
  PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.deps:/software/atac-seq-pipeline/src" python3 -c "import $mod" >> probe.txt 2>&1
  printf '%s_rc=%s\n' "$mod" "$?" >> probe.txt
done
PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.deps:/software/atac-seq-pipeline/src" python3 -c 'import caper; print(caper.__version__)' >> probe.txt 2>&1
printf 'caper_rc=%s\n' "$?" >> probe.txt
exit 0
